{"class": "one_plus_related",
 "explanation": "The unit responds to the faces of small furry mammals with upright, pointed ears, centred on cats and cat-like faces. It extends more weakly to similar-looking animals such as foxes, red pandas, lynx, fluffy small dogs and a hamster.",
 "evidence": "Domestic cats and kittens fill most of the top 20, and lynx appear several times. Foxes and red pandas rank highest (10), while a sheltie, a papillon and a hamster also score 7-8, so the shared feature looks like a fluffy, pointy-eared face rather than one species.",
 "missing_data": "Activations on dogs and other furry mammals without pointed ears, on non-mammal pointed shapes, and on images further down the ranking, which would show whether 'cat' or 'pointy-eared fluffy face' is the true core.",
